eval_details.counter_evidence: Taken together, this demonstrates that PKCζ is a critical metabolic tumor suppressor in mouse and human cancer.

eval_details.claim: cSMAC formation enhances weak ligand signalling.
eval_details.evidence: An in silico approach suggested that the inability to form the central supramolecular activation cluster (cSMAC) could underlie the increased proliferation. This conclusion was supported by experiments that showed that enhancing cSMAC formation reduced stimulatory capacity of the weak peptide.

eval_details.claim: mTORC2 regulates intracellular cysteine levels through xCT inhibition.
eval_details.evidence: mTORC2 phosphorylates serine 26 at the cytosolic N terminus of xCT, inhibiting its activity. Lysosomal degradation of extracellular proteins can sustain cell survival and induce activation of mTORC1 but fails to elicit significant cell accumulation.

eval_details.counter_evidence: Genetic inhibition of mTORC2, or pharmacologic inhibition of the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) kinase, promotes glutamate secretion, cystine uptake, and incorporation into glutathione, linking growth factor receptor signaling with amino acid uptake and utilization.
